args.query: CPI all items core consumer price index monthly

sql: select a.series, a.date, a.value, a.value/b.value*100-100 as mom_pct, a.value/c.value*100-100 as yoy_pct from econ.fred_indicators a left join econ.fred_indicators b on b.series=a.series and b.date = a.date - interval '1' month left join econ.fred_indicators c on c.series=a.series and c.date = a.date - interval '12' month where a.series in ('CPIAUCSL','CPILFESL') and a.date >= date '2026-01-01' order by a.series, a.date
select series, date, value from econ.fred_indicators where series='FEDFUNDS' and date >= date '2026-01-01' order by date

select a.date, a.value/c.value*100-100 as yoy_pct from econ.fred_indicators a join econ.fred_indicators c on c.series=a.series and c.date = a.date - interval '12' month where a.series='PCEPI' and a.date >= date '2020-10-01' and a.date<=date '2022-01-01' order by a.date

select min(a.value/c.value*100-100) as min_yoy, count(*) n from econ.fred_indicators a join econ.fred_indicators c on c.series=a.series and c.type=a.type and c.date = a.date - interval '12' month where a.series='CPIAUCNS' and a.date >= date '2021-03-01' and a.date<=date '2026-09-01'

select a.date, a.value/c.value*100-100 as yoy_pct from econ.fred_indicators a join econ.fred_indicators c on c.series=a.series and c.date = a.date - interval '12' month where a.series='PCEPI' and a.date >= date '2025-01-01' order by a.date
select "date", "value" from econ.fred_indicators where series='GDPC1' and "date">=date '2025-01-01' order by "date"
